action.objective: Verify Ke1 as the best continuation: tuck the king toward f2/g1 safety and free the d2 rook, checking for Black tactics.
action.rationale: Broad search at depth 3 (cutoff) gave Ke1 the exact top score -165, clearly ahead of Rd2a2 (-219 upper) and others. Ke1 moves the king off the d-file away from Black's rooks and bishop, avoiding f3-pawn forks. Verifying this single candidate at depth 4 with the reserved 2000 nodes to confirm safety and commit readiness.
